shared_elements: low-relief figure on a plain stone ground
justification: Both surfaces carry figures worked in shallow relief that stand out from a plain ground, and in each case an animal is rendered in profile with rounded, smoothly modelled body outlines and a curved arc-like element nearby, which is the strongest correspondence. But A shows essentially one eroded, hard-to-read creature spread across a boulder face, while B presents a structured multi-register composition — a top row of repeated arch-and-animal units, a woven/zigzag band, then separate panels with a canid, a bird and snake-like forms — a compositional scheme with no counterpart in A.
